fetchStatus.description: parse the cancel-only maintenance status, hand-authored flip of the captured payload

fetchTicker.description: parse the ticker endpoint fields, the requested instrument is deliberately not the first row

fetchTickers.description: parse the statistics endpoint fields, the open price and the quote volume

fetchBidsAsks.description: parse best bid and ask rows

fetchFundingRates.description: parse funding rates for all markets

fetchOpenInterests.description: parse open interests for all markets

fetchFundingRate.description: parse from the multi-row tickers payload, the endpoint ignores filters so the requested instrument is deliberately not the first row

fetchFundingRateHistory.description: parse funding history, the venue serves rows newest first

fetchOpenInterest.description: parse from the multi-row tickers payload, the endpoint ignores filters so the requested instrument is deliberately not the first row

fetchBalance.description: parse the margin summary into a balance

fetchPositions.description: parse a cross long and an isolated short position

fetchOpenOrders.description: parse open orders including a position-scoped stop loss

fetchOrder.description: parse one order, the requested row is deliberately not the first in case the venue ever ignores the filter

fetchMyTrades.description: parse a taker and a maker fill with fees

fetchWithdrawals.description: parse a pending withdrawal, the unmined hash collapses to null

fetchLeverage.description: parse the leverage configuration, the requested row is deliberately not the first

fetchMarginMode.description: parse the isolated margin mode, the requested row is deliberately not the first

createOrder.description: parse the accepted acknowledgement with the echoed client order id

editOrder.description: parse the modify acknowledgement, the short-name order row

withdraw.description: parse the withdraw acknowledgement, never tested live

createOrders.description: parse a partially accepted batch, the rejected element keeps a rejected status without throwing

cancelOrders.description: parse a partially accepted cancel batch

cancelAllOrders.description: parse the cancel all acknowledgement, the venue answers a bare object
